description: This file defines a class FavoritesStore that manages favorite recipe IDs using Android's SharedPreferences. It provides functions to get the current set of favorites, check if a specific recipe is favorite, and toggle favorites.

classes.name: FavoritesStore
classes.description: A simple key-value local store for favorite recipe IDs, utilizing SharedPreferences and Kotlin coroutines Flow to observe changes.

methods.name: FavoritesStore
methods.description: Constructor that initializes SharedPreferences and a MutableStateFlow with current favorite IDs.

methods.name: currentIds
methods.description: Retrieves the current set of favorite IDs from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: favorites
methods.description: Returns a Flow of the current set of favorite IDs.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Returns a Flow<Boolean> indicating whether a specific recipe ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Adds or removes a recipe ID from favorites and updates the shared preferences and flow.

methods.name: mapToBoolean
methods.description: Extension function that maps a Flow<Set<String>> to a Flow<Boolean> for a specific ID.
